scope: All shipped local TTF files and their embedded name records; original family OFL texts from a pinned official Google Fonts revision. This does not reconstruct the historical font-generation inputs.
modifications: Sans fonts are local static Regular 400 / Medium 500 shards; fallback shaping/layout tables were removed by the existing generation process. No font bytes changed in this review.
attribution_note: Embedded local copyright records are retained verbatim, in addition to upstream OFL texts. Their years sometimes differ; neither is rewritten or substituted for the other.
open_gaps: Historical variable-font input hashes, complete generation tool versions and reproducible shard-generation recipes were not retained; local derivative hashes and names do not prove exact upstream input identity.
